a.en: Main-street safety in major Chinese cities is on the good side globally, and violent crime against tourists is rare. What actually catches visitors out isn’t danger — it’s scams.
a.zh: 主要城市的街头治安在全球范围内属于较好的一档，针对游客的暴力犯罪很少见。真正要小心的不是「危险」，是「套路」。

en: Watch belongings in crowds — metro, shopping streets, park gates
Anyone approaching you near a sight to invite you to “tea”, an “exhibition” or a “jade shop”: decline flatly. It is the most common trap.
Disputes: call 110. No Chinese? Ask your hotel front desk to help.
zh: 人流密集处（地铁、步行街、景区入口）注意随身财物
景区周边主动搭讪、拉你去「喝茶 / 看展 / 买玉」的，一律婉拒——这是最常见的消费陷阱
遇到纠纷打 110；语言不通可先请酒店前台协助

src.en: Basis: MPS public security guidance and travel advisories for major Chinese cities, 2026.
src.zh: 依据：公安部治安提示与 2026 年主要城市旅行提示。

q.en: Will my phone work? Google / WhatsApp?
q.zh: 我的手机还能用吗？Google、WhatsApp 能上吗？

a.en: You’ll have internet — but not the apps you live on. Google, Gmail, Google Maps, WhatsApp, YouTube, Instagram and Facebook do not open on mainland networks, on mobile data or hotel Wi-Fi alike.
a.zh: 能上网，但不能直接用。Google、Gmail、Google 地图、WhatsApp、YouTube、Instagram、Facebook 在中国大陆网络下都打不开——无论连移动网络还是酒店 WiFi。

en: International roaming (keep your own SIM): simplest, routes abroad, those apps work — but about USD 5–15/day
Travel eSIM with overseas routing: the common choice, no VPN needed, live on landing
Local SIM + VPN: gets you a +86 number, but you must install the VPN before you fly — VPN sites don’t open once you’re in China
zh: 国际漫游（继续用自己的卡）：最省事，走境外网关，这些 App 正常；缺点是贵，约 5–15 美元/天
国际旅行 eSIM（多数人的选择）：数据走境外路由，不用装 VPN，落地即用
本地 SIM + VPN：能拿到 +86 号码，但必须出发前就装好 VPN（到了中国，VPN 网站本身打不开）

src.en: Basis: carrier roaming terms and independent 2026 field reports on eSIM routing. “eSIM” alone does not guarantee access — only overseas-routed ones do. When data routes overseas, Chinese apps like Alipay and Amap may fail: keep your home SIM for SMS.
src.zh: 依据：运营商漫游条款与 2026 年 eSIM 路由实测。「eSIM」不等于「能上」——只有走境外路由的才行。数据走境外路由时，支付宝、高德地图这类中国 App 可能报错或功能受限，所以最稳的组合是「境外 eSIM 走数据 + 保留原号收短信」。

a.en: Airports, chain hotels in big cities and major sights are mostly workable in English. Step off that line — taxis, small restaurants, smaller cities — and it’s Chinese almost everywhere.
a.zh: 机场、大城市的连锁酒店、热门景区，英文基本够用。一旦离开这条线——出租车、街边小店、小城市——几乎全是中文。

en: Improving fast: Tiantan Park has added 60+ AI translation devices, the Summer Palace runs English visitor surveys, and airports are rolling out multilingual guidance
Self-help kit: a translation app (download offline packs first) + a screenshot of your destination’s name in Chinese + your hotel’s Chinese card
Don’t struggle to ask: show the driver the Chinese address — far faster than saying it in English
zh: 这条线正在快速改善：天坛公园已引入 60 余台 AI 翻译设备，颐和园做了英文版游客问卷，多地机场铺开多语种引导
自助三件套：翻译 App（离线包先下好）+ 把目的地中文名截图存相册 + 拿一张酒店的中文名片
不确定就别硬问：把中文地址给司机看，比用英文说快得多

src.en: Basis: park authority announcements and airport service notices, 2026.
src.zh: 依据：园区管理方公告与 2026 年机场服务通报。

q.en: How do I pay? Is cash still usable?
q.zh: 怎么付钱？现金还有用吗？

a.en: China runs on QR codes almost everywhere — but you don’t need a Chinese bank account. Foreign cards bind directly.
a.zh: 中国几乎是「扫码社会」，但你不必办中国银行卡——境外卡可以直接绑。

en: Nihao China (UnionPay, tourism-board endorsed): bind an overseas UnionPay card, or top up a travel wallet with Visa / Mastercard / JCB. All English, no Chinese account.
Alipay / WeChat Pay: “bind foreign card” covers 7 major card networks; some regional wallets can also scan directly
Cash: RMB is legal tender and works everywhere face-to-face. Carry a little — 60,000+ bank branches and ~2,300 exchange points nationwide, most major ATMs take foreign cards
zh: Nihao China（中国银联推出、文旅局推荐）：可绑境外银联卡，也可用 Visa / Mastercard / JCB 给旅行钱包充值，全英文、无需中国账户
支付宝 / 微信支付：支付宝「外卡内绑」支持 7 大国际卡组织；部分境外钱包可直接扫码
现金：人民币是法定货币，所有面对面场景都能用。建议备少量——全国超 6 万家银行网点、近 2300 个兑换点，主要银行 ATM 支持境外卡取现

en: WeChat Pay with a foreign card: no platform fee under CNY 200 per transaction, 3% above
Alipay with an international credit card: 3% flat
zh: 微信支付用境外卡：单笔 200 元以内免平台服务费，超出收 3%
支付宝用国际信用卡：统一收 3%

en: Tell your bank before you travel you’ll be in China — it cuts fraud blocks sharply
Carry two cards from different banks; turn the VPN off when binding — a mismatched IP triggers security blocks
zh: 出发前告诉你的发卡行要去中国，能大幅降低风控拦截
准备两张不同银行的卡；绑卡时先关掉 VPN（IP 不匹配会触发安全拦截）

src.en: Basis: UnionPay / Nihao China official terms, 2026; card-network fee schedules.
src.zh: 依据：中国银联 / Nihao China 官方口径 2026；各卡组织费率表。

a.en: Flights and hotels are the big items; day-to-day spending often lands lower than most Western visitors expect. But there are three friction costs nobody warns you about.
a.zh: 机票和住宿是大头，日常消费往往比多数欧美游客预期的低。但有三笔「摩擦成本」没人提前告诉你。

en: 1  Payment platform fee: foreign cards via Alipay / WeChat, mostly 3%
2  Your bank’s foreign transaction fee: usually another 0–3%
3  Currency conversion spread — choosing “pay in my currency” at the terminal usually gives a worse rate
zh: ① 移动支付平台服务费：境外卡走支付宝 / 微信，多为 3%
② 发卡行的境外交易手续费：通常再加 0–3%
③ 货币转换差价——刷卡时如果选择「以本币结算」，汇率往往更差

en: Use Nihao China: no extra platform fee, settled at the UnionPay rate
Bring an overseas UnionPay card: swipe directly for big items and skip the 3%
Keep single transactions under CNY 200 on WeChat Pay to avoid the platform fee
zh: 用 Nihao China：无额外平台手续费，按银联汇率结算
带一张境外银联卡：大额直接刷卡，避开 3% 平台费
把单笔控制在 200 元以内：微信支付免平台服务费

tail.en: Shopping can refund part of it: the refund threshold is CNY 200, and over 8,000 stores offer refund-on-the-spot. See the Leaving screen.
tail.zh: 购物还能退回来一部分：离境退税起退点 200 元，全国「即买即退」商店已超 8000 家。详见「离境」那一屏。

src.en: Basis: published card-network and platform fee schedules; we deliberately do not quote a daily spend figure — it varies too much to be honest as one number.
src.zh: 依据：公开的卡组织与平台费率表；这里刻意不给「一天花多少钱」的绝对值——个体差异太大，拍一个数字反而不诚实。

a.en: If your passport is from one of 50 countries, most likely no visa — up to 30 days for tourism, business, family visits, exchange or transit. Two catches: your eligibility may have a shelf life, and a different itinerary gives a completely different answer.
a.zh: 如果你来自这 50 个国家之一，大概率不用办签证。但要小心两件事：你的资格可能「有保质期」，而且换个走法结论完全不同。

en: 50 countries unilateral visa-free: 30 days for tourism, family, business, exchange, transit — 48 of them are trials, running to 31 Dec 2026
240-hour transit visa-free, 57 countries: onward to a third country with a connecting ticket, 10 days, 65 ports
Hainan 30-day visa-free, 61 countries: within Hainan province only
Travel documents / temporary certificates are not eligible; work and study are outside all visa-free schemes
zh: 单方面免签 50 国：旅游、探亲、商务、交流、过境，停留不超过 30 天可免签入境。其中 48 国为「试行」，施行至 2026-12-31
240 小时过境免签 57 国：经中国前往第三国、持联程客票，可停留 10 天，65 个口岸
海南 30 天免签 61 国：仅限海南省行政区域内
持旅行证、临时证件不适用；来华工作、学习不在免签范围

src.en: Basis: National Immigration Administration announcement, Aug 2026; Chinese Visa Application Service Centre FAQ.
src.zh: 依据：国家移民管理局 2026-08 公告；中国签证申请服务中心官方 FAQ。

q.en: Who do I call if something goes wrong?

a.en: China runs an official multilingual help line for foreigners that almost no travel product bothers to tell you about.
a.zh: 中国有一套给外国人的官方多语种求助通道，但几乎没有旅游产品会主动告诉你。

en: 12367 — National Immigration Administration hotline, multilingual: entry, stay, registration
110 / 120 / 119 — police / ambulance / fire
Your own embassy in China: lost documents, emergencies
Solved already: a hotel refusing foreign guests for “no foreign-related qualification” is not valid in China — we turned that into the card you can show on the spot, on the In China screen
zh: 12367｜国家移民管理局热线，多语种，管出入境、居留、住宿登记这类问题
本国驻华使领馆：证件丢失、紧急情况
一个已经解决的旧问题：酒店以「没有涉外资质」为由拒住外国客人，在中国不成立——这条我们做成了可当场出示的话术，在「在路上」那一屏

src.en: Basis: NIA published hotline information, 2026; MPS / hotel-industry notices.
src.zh: 依据：国家移民管理局公开热线信息 2026；公安部及旅馆业相关通知。
